build_cuda_extension_utilslib: build a CUDA extension named utilslib from utils.cpp and utils_kernel.cu sources using PyTorch
build_extension_for_gpu_archs: build a CUDA extension targeting compute architectures 70, 80, and 86 with nvcc
setup_pytorch_cpp_extension: setup a PyTorch C++ extension using setuptools with CUDAExtension and BuildExtension
compile_utils_kernel_with_c++17: compile the utils CUDA kernel with C++17 standard and line info for debugging
run_setup_for_utils_ext: run the setup script to build the utils CUDA extension module for the goliath project
